state: Declared independent hypotheses before any execution; no observed Rust or RustGM acceptance claim. Preserve any disagreement as an invalid hypothesis rather than rewriting its source or expectation.

rows.name: field-literal-roundtrip
rows.hypothesis: One opaque field identifier selects the same declared FieldId through construction, pattern and access.

rows.name: field-captured-roundtrip
rows.hypothesis: Captured field tokens retain caller item identity independently of the generated record container.

rows.name: field-shorthand-local
rows.hypothesis: A shorthand field token participates in item-normalized field matching and separately in local-normalized value binding.

rows.name: field-capture-literal-distinct
rows.hypothesis: Same-spelling captured and opaque literal fields remain distinct within one captured-name record.

rows.name: field-private-definition-access
rows.hypothesis: A literal macro field use keeps provider definition-site privacy authority.

rows.name: field-private-captured-denied
rows.hypothesis: A captured caller field name does not acquire the macro definition privacy scope.

rows.name: field-private-caller-denied
rows.hypothesis: An ordinary caller cannot read a provider private field.

rows.name: field-functional-update-definition
rows.hypothesis: A definition-site record update may transfer private omitted fields while preserving the caller-owned base value.

rows.name: field-functional-update-caller-denied
rows.hypothesis: Caller record update cannot transfer private omitted fields merely because explicit fields are public.

rows.name: field-foreign-root-container
rows.hypothesis: A literal field use adjusts against the actual root-defined record, rather than its macro definition alone.

rows.name: field-foreign-opaque-denied
rows.hypothesis: A literal field from an unrelated opaque expansion cannot select an opaque field belonging to another container introduction.

rows.name: field-duplicate-declaration
rows.hypothesis: Two exact-identical declaration field identities reject even inside one opaque expansion.

rows.name: field-duplicate-initializer
rows.hypothesis: Two uses selecting the same FieldId reject as a duplicate initializer.

rows.name: field-ordinary-tuple-control
rows.hypothesis: Ordinary numeric tuple fields preserve index selection without a contextual field index.

rows.name: field-ordinary-record-control
rows.hypothesis: Ordinary root record shorthand preserves exact existing field and local behavior.
